control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
earth leakage and protection setting integrity
authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for P-3220

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus was not in place, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on P-3220 and M-3220 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. P-3220 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was not in place. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 7 May 2019 a planned critical control verification of P-3220 and M-3220 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the arc flash boundary and protective equipment not effective.
